annotations.title: Request a Callback from a Fox Davidson Broker

description: Prepare a callback request from a Fox Davidson mortgage broker. Returns a link to the Fox Davidson enquiry form with the topic, loan size and a short summary filled in, plus office hours and phone number. Nothing is sent or stored by this tool; the person adds their own contact details on the form and chooses whether to send it. Do not pass names, phone numbers or email addresses into this tool. Fox Davidson is a whole of market UK mortgage broker authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214).

loan_amount_gbp.description: Rough loan size in GBP, if known.

preferred_time.description: Best time to call, within office hours.

summary.description: A short summary of what the person needs. Do not include names, phone numbers or email addresses.
